I called back 2 days later after lunch and queried this, was told it hadn't been tested yet, this was back in April and I'm still waiting for the results (lol).

So I took somebodies call? And they told me their ailment? Thank god it wasn't something very personal.

I called this morning for a nurse, and was met with a very abrupt woman who asked what it was for, when I told her, she asked whether I'd done the relevant things doing needed before I make my visit, I said yes, she then asked my postcode and I must have gone in to quite a bad reception area, she then asked for my postode again, I tried to give her it, but she cut me off, she must have only heard HG4 because she responded with 'yes, everyone in the area has a HG4 postcode, I need the last part', I said (rather aggravated at this point, and also trying to move in to an area with better signal) I'd just given her it and tried to give her it again, only to be hung up on.
